mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM WHERE location_image_id IS NOT NULL

choose.when: UPDATE places SET location_image_id = goroute_nearest_location_image(latitude, longitude) WHERE location_image_id IS NULL AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND goroute_nearest_location_image(latitude, longitude) IS NOT NULL

UPDATE trips SET location_image_id = goroute_nearest_location_image(destination_lat, destination_lng) WHERE location_image_id IS NULL AND destination_lat IS NOT NULL AND destination_lng IS NOT NULL AND goroute_nearest_location_image(destination_lat, destination_lng) IS NOT NULL

UPDATE trip_destinations SET location_image_id = goroute_nearest_location_image(lat, lng) WHERE location_image_id IS NULL AND lat IS NOT NULL AND lng IS NOT NULL AND goroute_nearest_location_image(lat, lng) IS NOT NULL

UPDATE activity_bookings SET location_image_id = goroute_nearest_location_image(search_lat::NUMERIC, search_lng::NUMERIC) WHERE location_image_id IS NULL AND search_lat IS NOT NULL AND search_lng IS NOT NULL AND goroute_nearest_location_image(search_lat::NUMERIC, search_lng::NUMERIC) IS NOT NULL
choose.otherwise: UPDATE SET location_image_id = location_image_id WHERE FALSE

mapper.update: UPDATE hotel_profiles hp SET location_image_id = p.location_image_id FROM places p WHERE hp.location_image_id IS NULL AND p.id = hp.place_id AND p.location_image_id IS NOT NULL

UPDATE food_city_scores f SET location_image_id = li.id FROM location_images li WHERE f.location_image_id IS NULL AND ( (li.city_slug IS NOT NULL AND li.city_slug <> '' AND li.city_slug = f.city_slug) OR replace(li.normalized_address, ' ', '') = f.city_slug )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, concat_ws(' ', address, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(destinations) = 'array' THEN (SELECT string_agg(value, ' ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(destinations) AS value) END) AS match_text FROM places
SELECT id, destination AS match_text FROM trips
SELECT id, concat_ws(' ', address, name) AS match_text FROM trip_destinations
SELECT id, city_slug AS match_text FROM food_city_scores
SELECT id, concat_ws(' ', activity_address, departing_from, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(destinations) = 'array' THEN (SELECT string_agg(value, ' ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(destinations) AS value) END) AS match_text FROM activity_bookings
SELECT id, NULL AS match_text FROM hotel_profiles
WHERE location_image_id IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_booking_location_images (activity_booking_id, location_image_id) SELECT id, location_image_id FROM activity_bookings WHERE location_image_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
